dogecoin.text: Interesting thread coming from the creator of Dogecoin. Completely biased, false and short-sighted but interesting.

Ready for another unpopular opinion? No? Ok, I don't care:

The problem with the NFT scene is that 90% of it is just speculation right now. It's the same as Dogecoin, it's the same as the whole ICO stuff from 2017. And it attracts a lot of nasty people that only care about money.
